title: Privileged Access Separation-of-Duties & Break-Glass Approval Workflow
required_invariants: Self-approval (requester_id == approver_id) must always be rejected regardless of role.
Requested duration_hours must be within [1, 168]; values outside this range raise ValueError.
Production admin privileges require both manager_approved and security_approved unless break_glass with ticket_id is set.
Non-privileged read-only access with manager_approved and valid approver must be granted.
